Goal 6
Accelerate Global Education
Initiatives and Expand the University’s
International Footprint
The University’s Division of International Affairs has articulated a bold
vision to bring to fruition MORGAN GLOBAL over the next ten years.
This ambitious initiative will unfold over the next ten years and will
expand the University’s international footprint by enabling it to open
and operate “satellite campuses” in key locations around the world. These
international satellite campuses will serve two purposes:
1) To expand Morgan’s brand recognition around the world in
order to recruit and enroll more international students (in
Baltimore and overseas) and
2) support our domestic students to become truly global citizens
by allowing them to study abroad (short and long term) using
these international campuses.
These mutually reinforcing goals will be
achieved through the following means.
